classifications.exploratory-v1: Earlier candidate; never pool with final stable binaries.
classifications.exploratory-v1/variable: Incomplete superseded series; retains failures, continuation and rate misses.
classifications.final: Final stable series; completeness is determined by its original run artifacts.
classifications.invalid-clock: Invalid cross-process timing; original bytes and annotations retained.
classifications.validation: Raw logs include known failures; copying does not assert tests passed.

omission_count_unit: Observed entries; skipped directories count once and their contents are not inspected.
